note: The 1976 NFL season, computed from Pro Football Archives' facts: every player of its 28 clubs who played a game but the punters and long snappers, as [name, franchise (scripts/data/nfl-teams.json), the site's positions, game position, overall, { id: the site's player page, no: jersey, gp: games, gs: starts, value, played: the position a kicker also played, also: other clubs that season }], written by scripts/sync-pfa.mjs. The overall is ours (conversion).

source.compiler: Pro Football Archives (the facts); the overall ours

conversion.overall: Ours, computed: no game rated this NFL season. Each player's season value (his club's credit, its points per game against the league's to the power 0.25, offence and defence apart, shared out: the offensive line by starts; quarterbacks, backs, receivers and tight ends by production, rushing and receiving yards, 0.2 a passing yard, 40 a touchdown and less 60 an interception thrown, and by starts; defenders two thirds by starts and one third by plays, 2 a sack where recorded, 1.5 an interception, 1 a fumble recovered, 1 a return touchdown; kickers by field goals, extra points and accuracy against the league) is ranked among the league-season's players at his game position (ties by starts, then games played) and read off Madden NFL 2002's overalls at that position (the 2001 season: maddenratings.net's 31 team spreadsheets, punters left out), as many of each Madden team's best as the season carries per club, by linear interpolation; rounded and held to 1–99. Facts from Pro Football Archives; the weights tuned once on 2001–2005 against the next season's Madden launch ratings, then frozen.
